note: These emojis still upload through the sync. They are not regenerated until each family is reviewed and either mapped to a new source or kept permanently.

groups.reason: With Icons has no clean paddle, theatre or memory-stick mark.
With Icons has no plus/x/check ticket, tag-plus/x/tags or badge-help marks; forcing one would make unrelated log headings share or misread an icon.
With Icons ships UI artwork, not brand marks. The existing Simple Icons art is kept until a brand source is chosen.
With Icons has no cryptocurrency family; one coin would break the one-family rule for the payment row.
With Icons has no plain 0-9 digits, and a different digit family would be visibly inconsistent in paginators and help lists.
